quote: Connes made a remark in his 1976 paper 'Classification of Injective Factors' that 'apparently such an imbedding ought to exist for all II₁ factors because it does for the regular representation of free groups'
note: The problem originated as a remark in Connes' 1976 paper on the classification of injective factors in the Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 104, Issue 1, pages 73-115
